dedupe_keys.name: sugarcane press mud power production life cycle inventory

description: This deposit supplies simulation results and life-cycle inventory data for producing electricity from sugarcane press-mud under three scenarios. The Universidad de La Sabana research team’s article traces bioethanol, syngas, hydrogen and associated power-production processes. Current Mendeley metadata identify version 3 with an Excel results workbook and a catalyst-production inventory workbook; the article cites the earlier version 2, which was also verified. Both releases are free under CC BY 4.0. Geographic coverage concerns a process study associated with Colombia, not a national operating inventory, and no calendar observation period is established. The files combine modelled process flows with research assumptions, not measurements from complete commercial plants. A reviewer-assessed use is comparing waste-to-energy pathways or supplying inventory factors to infrastructure environmental-impact simulations. model-epa-warm-waste-reduction-model is a related waste-management assessment resource, but its factors and system boundaries were not harmonized with this deposit.
name: Sugarcane press-mud power-production life-cycle inventory
notes: G2 G2-0076. Metadata only. Proposed simulation uses are reviewer assessments. No data, archives or article PDFs downloaded; no simulation run.
